units.source_text: 似乎沙崩已经过去了，他想把脚尖再伸进去一点，但铁锹的影子也没有。

en.t: It seemed the sand slide had already passed, and he tried to push his toes in a little farther, but there was not even a trace of the shovel.

units.source_text: 不久，太阳的直射让人难以忍受。

en.t: Before long, the direct glare of the sun became unbearable.

units.source_text: 瞳孔收缩得很小……海蜇般跳着舞的胃袋……

en.t: His pupils shrank to tiny points... his stomach danced like a jellyfish...

units.source_text: 穿透额头的剧痛……再也不能流汗了……这就是限度。

en.t: A piercing pain drove through his forehead... he could no longer sweat... this was the limit.

units.source_text: 比这更要紧的是，铁锹丢哪儿去了？

en.t: More urgent than that, where had the shovel gone?

units.source_text: ……那时肯定拿出来当武器来看……是啦，这样的话，该埋在那边……

en.t: ...Back then he must have taken it out to use as a weapon... yes, in that case, it should be buried over there...

units.source_text: 透过地面一看，立刻辨别出沙子上鼓起来的铁锹形状。

en.t: Looking across the ground, he immediately made out the shape of the shovel bulging up under the sand.
